$comment: The feature surface, once. Every route in server/routes, every `anydag` command and every MCP tool is named here, and test/parity.test.ts fails on one that is not — or on a name here that no longer exists. An interface is a list of names (done), {"via": [...], "why"} (covered by something more general), or {"refused"} (not offered, and why). docs/PARITY.md is generated from this: `npm run parity`.
